name: AXM Evidence Chain Recovery Adapter Conformance Lab
actions: bind an adapter fixture profile to exact evidence-chain source, candidate, and application-plan digests
exercise synthetic permission denial, exact confirmation, preview expiry, candidate tamper, and target drift probes
exercise a complete fixture apply, independent digest inspection, rollback preview, rollback, and final inspection
reject adapter fixture responses that expose paths, payloads, identities, tokens, or raw bytes
emit a digest-only conformance receipt that preserves the missing live-application capability
summary: Proves that a fixture-mode evidence-chain recovery adapter obeys fail-closed preview, apply, inspection, and rollback contracts before live authority is considered.
notes: Conformance-fixture-only. The Lab loads no adapter path, calls no Recovery Center or network service, requests no permission, and touches no filesystem or live target. Passing does not provide capability.apply.evidence-chain-reviewed-recovery/v1 or prove real identity authorization.
